interpretation.primary: E exceeds N by 64 accepted proposal occurrences across 4096 matched block/window comparisons; average 0.015625 per block. This raw scoring audit does not itself rerun the separate statistical confidence-interval calculation.
interpretation.decomposition: 47 fewer lost prefix occurrences plus 17 more acquired occurrences account for the 64-position E-minus-N difference.
interpretation.prefix_units: An accepted prefix excludes the known seed and includes a matching EOS. Fully matching available cap suffixes are censored.
interpretation.P_and_H: P is each exact current pre-window checkpoint; H applies native Adam history and decay with zero current gradients. Neither is a released frozen baseline.
interpretation.source_vs_transfer: The retained source summary reports stronger fitting for N than E (net +2809 versus +1966 source occurrences); source logits are outside this native raw-token audit. This is a separate conditioning/population comparison.
interpretation.Adam_limit: E-minus-H interval includes zero; this does not establish equivalence or isolate the benefit of current error gradients from optimizer history.
interpretation.local_only: All 16 E/C/H branches are disposable one-step interventions along N, not an E-trained trajectory. No serving latency, full-generation gain, deployed improvement or general prefix-gradient harm is established.
interpretation.scale: Effects of gradient magnitude, clipping, Adam history and BF16 remain unresolved by this screen.

publication_allowed: Per-request/window scalar outcome tables with approved synthetic request IDs
private_evidence: Sealed raw request definitions and token-bearing manifests
